subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `resetSession` become a public capability only for `after_compaction`, or a general API on every embedded `PluginHookAgentContext`?
rationale: The PR currently publishes a broader plugin contract than the motivating compaction workflow requires, and narrowing that contract after release would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Scope to after-compaction
options.body: Attach the method only to after-compaction contexts and keep reset construction in a narrow leaf module, minimizing capability and compatibility surface.

options.title: Approve a general hook API
options.body: Keep it on general embedded hook contexts, but document supported hook phases and prove safe reset semantics for non-compaction hooks before merge.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Keep session reset out of hook contexts until maintainers define a broader plugin lifecycle-control contract.

recommendation.title: Scope to after-compaction
recommendation.body: Attach the method only to after-compaction contexts and keep reset construction in a narrow leaf module, minimizing capability and compatibility surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects Gateway session lifecycle guarantees and the public plugin contract that invokes them.
